# spIBDerverse

The goal of spIBDerverse is to give a series of function to apply ERGMs
to IBD networks.

## Installation

You can install the development version of spIBDerverse from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jonotuke/spIBDerverse")
```

## Example

``` r

library(spIBDerverse)
```

# Data

The fundemental object for the `spIBDerverse` package is the IBD
network. You are create this using two `TSV` files.

## IBD dataset (edge info)

The first file is the IBD file. It should have the following headers.

``` R
#> -  iid1 
#> -  iid2 
#> -  max_IBD 
#> -  sum_IBD>8 
#> -  n_IBD>8 
#> -  sum_IBD>12 
#> -  n_IBD>12 
#> -  sum_IBD>16 
#> -  n_IBD>16 
#> -  sum_IBD>20 
#> -  n_IBD>20
```

## Meta dataset (node info)

The next file needed is the meta file. This can contain any meta-data
about the samples, but needs two columns:

1.  `iid` this has the sample IDs and must have an entry for each of the
    IDs mentioned in the `iid1` and `iid2` column of the IBD file.
2.  A `frac_gp` column.

## Creating the IBD network.

There are example files within the `spIBDerverse` package that can be
used as an example. These can be obtained with

``` r

ibd_file <- fs::path_package(
  "extdata",
  "example-ibd-data.tsv",
  package = "spIBDerverse"
)
meta_file <- fs::path_package(
  "extdata",
  "example-meta-data.tsv",
  package = "spIBDerverse"
)
```

We convert these to an IBD network with

``` r

ibd_network <- load_ibd_network(
  ibd_file,
  meta_file,
  ibd_co = c(0, 2, 1, 0),
  frac_co = 0.49
)
```

``` r

ibd_network
#> IGRAPH e5f6887 UN-- 328 2103 -- 
#> + attr: name (v/c), frac_gp (v/n), frac_missing (v/n), frac_het (v/n),
#> | n_cov_snp (v/n), Archaeological_ID (v/c), Master_ID (v/c), Projects
#> | (v/c), Locality (v/c), Province (v/c), Country (v/c), Latitude (v/n),
#> | Longitude (v/n), date (v/c), date_type (v/c), imputation_type (v/c),
#> | .degree (v/n), .closeness (v/n), .betweenness (v/n), .eigencentrality
#> | (v/n), frac_gp1 (e/n), frac_gp2 (e/n), max_ibd (e/n), sum_ibd_8
#> | (e/n), n_ibd_8 (e/n), sum_ibd_12 (e/n), n_ibd_12 (e/n), sum_ibd_16
#> | (e/n), n_ibd_16 (e/n), sum_ibd_20 (e/n), n_ibd_20 (e/n), wij (e/n)
#> + edges from e5f6887 (vertex names):
#> [1] KUP007--KUP023 RKC013--RKC029 RKC031--RKF238 RKF195--RKF196 RKC020--RKF142
#> + ... omitted several edges
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`abbreviate_terms()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/abbreviate_terms.md)
  : abbreviate labels
- [`add_clustering()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/add_clustering.md)
  : Add clusters
- [`add_convert_bb_adj()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/add_convert_bb_adj.md)
  : Adjust BB for network work sf object
- [`add_layout()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/add_layout.md)
  : add layout
- [`add_stars()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/add_stars.md)
  : add stars to p-values
- [`check_node_attributes()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/check_node_attributes.md)
  : checks that vector of names are node attributes in a given network
- [`clean_models()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/clean_models.md)
  : clean model names
- [`clean_network()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/clean_network.md)
  : Clean network
- [`convert_bb()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_bb.md)
  : Given a bounding box, increase the lat and long by given amounts
- [`convert_bb_asp()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_bb_asp.md)
  : convert bb to be square
- [`convert_na_unknown()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_na_unknown.md)
  : converts NA to unknown
- [`convert_nas_unknown()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_nas_unknown.md)
  : converts all NAs in node attributes
- [`convert_pipe()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_pipe.md)
  : convert pipe
- [`convert_pred_ergmterm()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_pred_ergmterm.md)
  : convert_pred_terms
- [`convert_ringbauer_measures()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_ringbauer_measures.md)
  : Convert ringbauer measures
- [`convert_to_network()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/convert_to_network.md)
  : Convert to network from igraph, but keep original names
- [`cutoff_input_id()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/cutoff_input_id.md)
  : Input id for the cutoff control of one attribute
- [`default_image`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/default_image.md)
  : default image
- [`dist_network`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/dist_network.md)
  : dist network
- [`drop_missing_nodes()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/drop_missing_nodes.md)
  : drop_missing_nodes
- [`edges_to_sf()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/edges_to_sf.md)
  : edges to sf
- [`ergm_pairwise()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/ergm_pairwise.md)
  : Get pairwise differences for a categorical predictor in an ergm
  model
- [`example_network`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network.md)
  : example network
- [`example_network_2`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_2.md)
  : example network 2
- [`example_network_3`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_3.md)
  : example network 3
- [`example_network_4`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_4.md)
  : example network 4
- [`example_network_5`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_5.md)
  : example network 5
- [`example_network_6`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_6.md)
  : example network 6
- [`example_network_7`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_network_7.md)
  : Example network of 20 European cities
- [`example_spatial_ergms`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/example_spatial_ergms.md)
  : example spatial ergms
- [`expand_line()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/expand_line.md)
  : Expand a line by given amount
- [`filter_network()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/filter_network.md)
  : Filter network
- [`fit_ergms()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/fit_ergms.md)
  : fit_ergms

  : Get the observed values of a node or edge attribute
- [`get_centrality_measures()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_centrality_measures.md)
  : Get centrality measures
- [`get_clustering_measures()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_clustering_measures.md)

- [`get_connected_graph()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_connected_graph.md)
  : get_connected_graph
- [`get_dist()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_dist.md)
  : Get geodistance for points in network
- [`get_edge_info()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_edge_info.md)
  : Get network edge information
- [`get_ergm_bic()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_ergm_bic.md)
  : Tabulate the ergm AIC and BIC
- [`get_ergm_coef()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_ergm_coef.md)
  : Gets coefficients and fold changes for a ergm model
- [`get_ergm_fc()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_ergm_fc.md)
  : Convert ergm coefficients to fold changes
- [`get_ergm_preds_df()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_ergm_preds_df.md)
  : Classify the predictors (terms) of a fitted ergm
- [`get_network_summary()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_network_summary.md)
  : Get network summary
- [`get_node_attributes()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_node_attributes.md)
  : get node attributes
- [`get_node_info()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_node_info.md)
  : Get network node information
- [`get_palettes()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_palettes.md)
  : List available palettes
- [`get_ringbauer_measures()`](https://jonotuke.github.io/spIBDerverse/reference/get_ringbauer_measures.md)
